title: Cyranides I.1 binds plant-part flow treatments to duration and an astral/amulet exception
summary: A complete Cyranides I.1 chain distinguishes plant part, preparation/route, bodily or flow effect, amount/duration, a mixture that prevents worsening/return, and a later decan-linked quartan-disease amulet branch. This is a source-specific content graph beyond plant-name incidence.

design.mechanism: A reusable botanical material is typed by part and route, receives bodily/flow effects plus explicit durations or amounts, and can switch to a contrary or astral-conditioned wearable branch with a stone/fish alternative.
design.source_example: Cyranides Book I chapter 1, sections 1-10, 18, 21, 23 and 35-39: white vine root/leaf/stem/fruit operations, seven-day and other durations, stone mixture preventing recurrence, first-decan Capricorn quartan cause, grape-seed neck amulet and fish-stone alternative.
design.target_endpoint: Already admitted complete paragraph/content caches summarized by GDT928/GDT735; no target text, labels, images, or new selectors were opened.

two_readings.name: compound timed medical-astral regimen
consequences: A material/part relation should control a bodily or flow result together with an amount or duration, without requiring one whole-word name.
A marked contrary or decan branch should change route from ingestive treatment to a wearable botanical/stone alternative while retaining a relation to the disease or recurrence condition.

two_readings.name: heterogeneous medical and occult compendium
consequences: Medical part/route/effect/duration frames can recur independently of astral or amulet frames.
The stone/fish substitution and decan clause need not scope over the preceding plant treatments; recurrence alone carries no cross-register link.

design.smallest_distinguishing_observation: In a complete source-frozen target passage, one reusable component must link a part-specific bodily/flow operation and fixed time/amount to a separately marked contrary or astral/amulet route switch; the rival predicts independent frame distribution.
design.nearest_rival: An editorially heterogeneous medical recipe and occult-note compendium, or a flat plant catalogue with local duration and substitution fields.
assumption_costs: Target operation, route, duration, and exception/alternate-object positions can be fixed without English glosses.
A compiled Greek magical-medical chapter is a relevant content analogue for an admitted target passage.
The decan clause and amulet are allowed to be a source-linked branch but are not assumed to be one causal theory.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The target may have medical procedures but no astral/amulet register, or the source's mixed compilation may not encode one cross-register chain; then the proposed relation cannot beat the heterogeneous rival.
design.falsifier: A source-frozen target model repeatedly separates part/effect/duration from every exception or alternate-object route, or treats the alleged contrary branch as the same ordinary outcome without a marked scope change.

primary_sources.locator: Cyranides Book I, chapter 1, sections 1-39; Greek digital edition based on the 1898 edition
primary_sources.source_limit: Digital Greek edition/transcription and compiled text; source architecture does not establish a Voynich identification or a single coherent causal theory.
